title: Organising events that keep Cardano in the news in Japan

ms.promise:
・Selection of locations
・Selection of speakers and outreach
・Finding event partners and sponsors to cover as many costs as possible and to give the event media exposure
・Setting ticket prices
・Placing adverts promoting the event
・Determining the event program
・Selling tickets
・Arranging catering
・Media exposure
・Making the event fun and exciting
・Create collaboration opportunities
・Follow up with participants, speakers, and partners, collect participant surveys, and plan the next event
ms.criteria:
・Do events 3 times
・Number of visitors: 300 or more
・Number of participating projects: 15 or more
・Total number of social media impressions: 150,000 or more
・Number of #Cardano hashtags: 300 or more
・Total number of followers of influential people: 100,000 or more
・Increase in Cardano X followers by 200 or more
